question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Teja followed his friend’s advice so now he is __in deep water__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. In trouble.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"in deep water"** means to be in a difficult or troublesome situation. (मुसीबत में होना)

 
 
• **Example:** After missing several important deadlines, he found himself in deep water with his boss.
 
 
 
• **"In trouble"** refers to being in a problematic or challenging situation. (परेशानी में)
 
 
• **Example:** She realized she was in trouble when she lost her wallet in a foreign country.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. In trouble.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **In dilemma** (दुविधा में): A situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives.

 
 
• **Example:** She was in a dilemma about whether to attend the meeting or finish her report.
 
 
 
• **In good position** (अच्छी स्थिति में): Being in a favorable or advantageous situation.
 
 
• **Example:** After getting a promotion, he is now in a good position at the company.
 
 
 
• **In deep thoughts** (गहरी सोच में): Being engrossed in serious contemplation or reflection.
 
 
• **Example:** She was in deep thoughts about her future career plans.
